scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); fs.copyFileSync('content.css', 'dist/content.css'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/popup', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('popup/popup.html', 'dist/popup/popup.html'); fs.copyFileSync('popup/popup.css', 'dist/popup/popup.css'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/icons', {recursive:true}); ['icon16.png','icon48.png','icon128.png'].forEach(function(f){ try { fs.copyFileSync('icons/'+f, 'dist/icons/'+f); } catch(e) {} });"
